detailed_descriptions.en: Le Mans Ultimate goes stateside for a brand new challenge! The first of 3 track packs with 6 new circuits includes 2 of the most iconic road circuit racing tracks in the US - including the world-famous Daytona International Speedway ! Located in Daytona Beach, Florida, approximately 50 miles north of Orlando, Daytona International Speedway has been the home of the Daytona 500 since opening in 1959. Built by NASCAR founder Bill France Sr., the circuit bills itself as the " World Center of Racing " and although features four distinct layouts: the main 3.56-mile sports car road course will be in game at launch. The venue is also the home of the famous 24 Hours of Daytona, one of three races comprising the Triple Crown of endurance racing and now traditionally the curtain raiser for the IMSA WeatherTech Sportscar Championship. One of the most unique features of Daytona is that its endurance races combine the speed of a superspeedway with technical infield sections, forcing teams to balance aerodynamics, reliability and driver endurance. The track’s long history, night racing atmosphere and connection to sports car legends make it one of the most iconic endurance racing venues in the world. WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca , located near Monterey, California, is one of the most iconic road courses in North American motorsport. Opened in 1957, the circuit is famous for its dramatic elevation changes, technical corners, and the legendary Corkscrew turn, where drivers drop approximately 60 feet through a blind left-right combination. The track remains a favorite among drivers because it rewards precision rather than just speed. Its signature Corkscrew, limited run-off areas, and challenging combination of fast and slow corners make it a true test of car setup, driver skill, and endurance racing strategy. Content included: Daytona International Speedway WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Speedway

One of the most unique features of Daytona is that its endurance races combine the speed of a superspeedway with technical infield sections, forcing teams to balance aerodynamics, reliability and driver endurance.

The track’s long history, night racing atmosphere and connection to sports car legends make it one of the most iconic endurance racing venues in the world.
